# David Gabeau

> Founder and CEO of Tapestry. Previously engineer at Snap and Lyft, analyst at Union Square Ventures. Based in New York.

## About

David Gabeau is a founder and software engineer in New York. He dropped out of NYU, learned to code, and worked as a quality engineer at Snap and Lyft before each went public. He then joined Union Square Ventures as an analyst, focused on early-stage crypto, climate, and education companies. He founded Tapestry, a permissionless social graph protocol on Solana, and is now looking for a role at the frontier of AI.

## Projects

- [Tapestry](https://usetapestry.dev): A permissionless social graph protocol for onchain applications. Backed by Union Square Ventures, Redpoint, Slow Ventures, Fabric Ventures, Stellation, and Harlem Capital. Tapestry lets any application read and write to a shared social graph on Solana without permission from a platform.
- [Zumi](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zumi-chat-dress-up/id6751237911): An AI companion app built on Tapestry with 160,000+ users. Focused on persistent AI companionship and long-term relationships.
- [Primitives](https://techcrunch.com/2022/05/25/primitives-crypto-wallet-social-network-snapchat-startup/): A platform for collecting digital art and building community around on-chain objects. 500,000+ NFTs minted.
- [SSE](https://sse.gg): A trading platform for Solana memecoins and emerging tokens. $50M in volume.
- [AI Atlas NYC](https://aiatlas.nyc): A nightly-rebuilt market map of New York's early-stage AI ecosystem. An agent scrapes funding announcements, LinkedIn signals, and founder activity, re-clusters the map, and publishes a new version each morning. Data is served via a public REST API.
